name: local-ai-commit
description: Generate git commit messages from the Source Control view with the AI CLI you already have: Claude Code or Antigravity.

enumDescriptions: Use Antigravity inside the Antigravity IDE and Claude Code elsewhere, falling back to the other when its CLI is not installed.
Always use the Claude Code CLI (`claude`).
localAiCommit.provider.description: Which AI CLI writes the commit message.

localAiCommit.instructions.description: Extra instructions appended to the prompt (e.g. language, scope rules, ticket prefixes).

localAiCommit.claudeModel.description: Model alias or ID passed to `claude --model` (e.g. haiku, sonnet, opus).

localAiCommit.claudePath.description: Path to the claude executable. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the Claude Code extension, falling back to `claude` on PATH.

localAiCommit.antigravityModel.description: Model ID passed to `agy --model` (run `agy models` to list them). Leave empty to use the CLI's default model.

localAiCommit.antigravityPath.description: Path to the agy executable. Leave empty to look in `~/.local/bin` and `~/.gemini/bin`, falling back to `agy` on PATH.
